trello.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
trello.desc: Marcus to fix the NullPointerException in the media picker callback that occurs when a user backgrounds the app mid-upload on Android 14. Currently about 4% of Android sessions. Repro: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. Must be fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA has time before the August 20 release.

trello.name: Verify Android crash fix on test devices
trello.desc: Sam to confirm the Android 14 photo upload crash fix on Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it, and add it to the regression run.

trello.name: Build sync API for offline notes
trello.desc: Elena to build the backend sync API endpoint this sprint: client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; no merge UI in this pass. Elena to have the sync API in review before she is out on the 17th and 18th.

trello.name: Implement client-side offline mode for notes list
trello.desc: Marcus to implement the client side of offline notes: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria: open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when back online with no data loss. Marcus to write these acceptance criteria into the ticket.

trello.name: Migrate CI pipelines to GitHub Actions
trello.desc: Sam to finish the test and release pipelines for the GitHub Actions migration, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both GitHub Actions and Jenkins systems in parallel for one week before turning Jenkins off. Jenkins must stay alive until the parallel week is clean. Sam already has a proof of concept for the build job.

trello.name: Add per-user rate limiting to search endpoint
trello.desc: Elena to add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that limit. Also add a metrics counter so we can see who is hitting the limit. This addresses the incident where a misbehaving script degraded the search endpoint for everyone last week.

trello.name: Update consent screen for GDPR compliance
trello.desc: Marcus to update the privacy policy/consent screen so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. Marcus to get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. This is a launch blocker and must be in the August 20 release for the EU launch.

trello.name: Write regression tests for payments flow
trello.desc: Sam to write automated regression tests for the payments flow covering purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline. This addresses the lack of automated coverage that caused issues in the last release.
